jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: Newport City School District, a city school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member: City of Newport). Operates Newport City Elementary School (K-6). The board's POST (five seats) was built 2026-10-28 from the NCSU board page roster supplied through Tiffany Gray's reply; all five memberships are held pending member-level seating documents (see the board's sources). The district is modeled as it stands; the city's draft charter revision (adoption vote November 3, 2026) is not evidence of current structure.
Newport City Elementary School (official site; carries the board vacancy notice).

sources.note: North Country Supervisory Union, Newport City School Board page (official; the source NCSU Executive Assistant Tiffany Gray pointed to in her 2026-10-28 reply to CivicMirror's records request): the 2026-2027 roster is Maryellen Maclure (Chair), Carrie Ann Roberge (Vice Chair), Mary Ellen Prairie (Clerk), Elizabeth (Betsy) Daly and Jacques Nadeau -- five members, establishing the board at FIVE seats (the 2025-2026 roster was the same five except Debra Prue in place of Nadeau). NO MEMBERSHIPS ARE MINTED YET: the page publishes no term ends and no member-level seating document was fetched for any of the five; Nadeau's arrival coincides with the school's advertised board vacancy (appointment to the March 2027 town meeting, per the Newport City Elementary homepage notice) but no minutes recording his appointment were fetched, so his mode is undocumented; and NCSU's own pages spell two names inconsistently (the board page's 'Maryellen Maclure' / 'Mary Ellen Prairie' against the Full Board page's 'Mary Ellen Maclure' / 'Maryellen Prairie'), so canonical name forms await a ballot or annual-report source. Resolving documents: the board's September/October 2026 minutes (Nadeau's appointment) and the district's FY2027 annual report or March 2026 warning (term expirations and name forms). A follow-up request for those documents has been drafted for the district (unsent).
